{{Quote|There are many loyal Senators confused as can be about this appointment, but you have to realize, regardless of his bluster and Palpatine-bashing, Farr is the perfect image of a loyalist. He hates the Separatists. He loves the Republic. And he's willing to do anything to preserve it.|Dassid Whateel|<ref name="HNN55">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|news/1359_4.html|Senator Farr Named to Loyalist Committee}}</ref>}}
'''Dassid Whateel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] political analyst of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and a commentator for [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], on the morning talk-show ''[[Amberdawn]]'', shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Whateel was interviewed by HoloNet News following the appointment of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] to the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]], a move which he claimed not to be surprising as Farr was the "perfect image of a loyalist."
